goal: Den minimalen read-only TUI-Connection-Ownership-Vertrag festlegen, ohne Provider, Starter, Writer-Lifecycle oder eingefrorene Bereiche zu verändern

guide_delta.summary: I78 autorisiert einen äußeren TUI-Composition-Owner für genau eine gemeinsam geliehene read-only Connection; TuiDataPort, späterer Health-Provider und ProvowareDbTui erhalten keine Close-Ownership.

tests_required: confirm ProvowareDbTui remains a consumer of injected TuiDataPort
confirm open_connection(read_only=True) remains the existing technical factory seam
confirm web lifecycle remains isolated and unchanged
confirm I78 write scope contains documentation and manifest only
Manifest V2 and strict write_files scope validation green
tests_explicitly_not_run: product tests because no product code changes
database regressions because storage is untouched
TUI runtime tests because runtime is untouched
full suite because I78 is scope-only
visual evidence because no UI changes exist
risks: the authorized ownership contract still needs a later concrete composition implementation
writer connections must not be silently folded into this read-only ownership
non_changes: no events, writer lifecycle or starter wiring
expected_side_effects: a later read-only provider may share the single composition-owned connection with the TUI data path
ProvowareDbTui remains free of connection and close ownership
